text: Afterburner is one of Lao's two Signature Arts in . It is a Sniper Rifle Art. Cross learns this art after completing The Matchmaker.

Amdusias is a Heavy Type based Skell unit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Amdusias is one of the Skells developed by BLADE in New Los Angeles. The Amdusias vehicle is a treaded heavy vehicle, resembling a futuristic army tank. The level 60 upgrade of this Skell is the Amdusias Hades.

Agniratha, Mechonis Capital (帝都アグニラータ, Agni Ratha, Imperial Capital, alternatively Imperial Capital Agniratha) is a Field Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 16 of disc 4 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is heard during the day while the party is in Agniratha.
The Agni Tablet Shop is a shop in , located in Makna Forest, located near the Agni Tablet. A Nopon Merchant sells a small selection of items, but no art manuals.

Alfombra, the Transcendent (Japanese: , Bodai no Arufonbura) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Tectinsula, and can be found hidden at level 14 at the Humdrum Peaks in Noctilum. Defeating it is required for the eponymous Basic Mission Alfombra, the Transcendent.

Aganeba (Japanese: , Aganeba) is an NPC in . He is a Ma-non and can be found in the Starboard side of the Ma-non Ship. He is the creator of the Aganeba Alloy, and a secondary client in The Pip-Squeak.

Alba Lepyxes (Japanese: , Aruba Fontera) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Lepyx family, and can be found at level 18-20 on Oblivia's Aaroy Plain, east of the Twin Arches.
Alesa (Japanese: , Aresa) is an NPC in . She can be found in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles, between Central Melville Street and Barista Court.

Almandal (Japanese: , Arumandaru) is a Ganglion Skell and a Main Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is fought at level 28 near Ruins on the Sandbank in Oblivia during Chapter 7. It is Goetia's personal Skell. Speaking with On'tonam after completing Chapter 7 and the Normal Mission Sun'celeg Rises reveals that the Orpheans were the ones who built it.
Ajira Melons (Japanese: , Ajirauri) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia. Eight of them are needed during A New Taste Sensation.

The Alexa Special (Japanese: , Akusena Supesharu) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Human-Made Skell with a Urban frame produced by Sakuraba Industries. It is fought at level 16, piloted by Alexa, at Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District during Weaponized. This fight is requested by Alexa in order to test a weapon prototype.
Alba Femina Suids (Japanese: , Aruba Femina Zūsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Suid family, and can be found at level 23 near Keegan Ridge in Oblivia.

Ajoa Byers (Japanese: , Ajoa) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Water Purification Plant in the Residential District of New Los Angeles. After Water Woes is completed, she can be found at the Biahno Water-Purification Plant in Primordia, until Lakeside Getaway is completed. She is a staff member of the Biahno water-purification plant and works as the "Chief Researcher". After completing Lakeside Getaway during which indigens attacked the Biahno water-purification plant and a mission route is chosen, she will either be dead or undergoing surgery to get the eggs removed.
Alex (Japanese: , Arekkusu) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at West Melville Street in the Commercial District in New Los Angeles.
Alan (Japanese: , Aran, English dub: ) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found just inside the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District.
Alice (Japanese: , Arisu) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Cathedral in the Residential District of New Los Angeles.

Amana Durians (Japanese: , Amana Dorian) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum, near FN Site 221 and Humdrum Peaks. Four of them are needed for BLADE Mission No. 1's Squad Task.
Affinity Soulchains (Japanese: , Souruchēn ) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum, in particular at the Delusians North Summit.

Alba Blattas (Japanese: , Aruba Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family. They can be found at level 15-18 at Oblivia Ingress, the alcoves on the path leading to Big Arch, southeast of FN Site 312, and under Leaning Ring in Oblivia. They are usually gathered around suid corpses.

Alexei, the Jade (Japanese: , Hisui no Arekusei) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Monoceros family. It can be found at level 35 at the northern region of West Ciel Sandsea in Sylvalum.

Agnes, the Divine-Scaled (, Tenrin no Agunisu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Tersqual family. It can be found at level 67 south of FN Site 506 in Cauldros in the middle of a rock formation. It reflects thermal damage.

Agito, the Golden (Japanese: , Ōgon no Agito) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Blatta family. It can be found at level 36-40 near Shadow Rise in Primordia at night, hidden on a vertical rock face until approached, on one of the stone columns that supports the miniature rock formation resembling Talon Rock above Shadow Rise.

Ald, the Extravagant (Japanese: , Ōgyoku no Arudo) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Blatta family. It can be found at level 61-65 in Sylvalum's Quay Hollows, hiding on a ledge in the northwest corner.

Aeviters (Japanese: , Tidāra) are Insectoid creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are almost always found dormant, and will attack if approached. When attacking, they use a melee physical art and numerous ranged ether arts. They can be found in Noctilum and Sylvalum. They are similar to Ictuses, and are large enough to be staggered then binded.

Albin, the Wicked Meddler (Japanese: , Amanojaku Howaiti) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Purgovent family. It can be found at level 56 at west Lake Ciel in Sylvalum during nighttime.

Ahama, the Covetous (Japanese: , Katsubō no Ahama) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Marnuck Ganglion member. It can be found at level 60 at the Cavernous Abyss in Sylvalum during the day. Ahama appears on a ledge above the western side of the abyss.

Alithios, the Indignant (Japanese: , Ikidōri no Arisiosu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Gularth family. It can be found at level 81 at M'gando Volcanic Crater in Cauldros during brimstone rain.

The Air Support Galdr (Japanese: , Kōkū Shien-gata Garudora) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Galdr machine. It can be found at level 54 at Wildcat Fortress in Cauldros during nighttime.

Ahama's Seidr (Japanese: , Ahama Sen'yō Basugia) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Seidr Ganglion machine. It can be found at level 84 northeast of Anvil Sandplain in Sylvalum at night. It is the Seidr of Ahama, the Covetous.
Aganeba Alloy is an Important Item in . It is created by Aganeba during the course of The Pip-Squeak and must be delivered to Matthew.

Amdusias Hades is a Heavy Skell in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the level 60 version of the Amdusias Skell and becomes available after completing Chapter 12. Like all other Level 60 Skells it cannot be purchased, but instead must be created at the AM Terminal.

Aegis Raptor Seidr (Japanese: , Ījisuraputā Basugia) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Seidr machines, Ganglion Skells, and can be found at level 46-47 in the skies around Emerian Battlegrounds and Boxtrap Checkpoint in Cauldros.

All-Purpose Plugs are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Galdrs. One is required during Pack It In. They are components of Electric-Floods, Hexad-Particans, and Zweihand-Qs.

Ajiba Falgo (Japanese: , Ajiba Farugo) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Bosses in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 17-20 in Oblivia. He is fought at level 19 in Oblivia's Milligan Supply Base during the Normal Mission Kidnapped: Oll Valdileo.
Agile Gunslinger is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Commando at rank 2. Cross, Elma, Murderess, and Phog can use this skill.
Aggro Boost is a Skill in . It is unlocked as a Duelist at rank 3.

Alex's Last Stand (Japanese: , Risō, Ideals) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Eliza in Ishmael Hills in the Residential District. Although not required, the Basic Mission Settling the Score can be used to locate this mission.

The Agile Caecus (Japanese: , Aguru Doren) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Caecus family, and is fought at level 25 near Cascade Isle in Noctilum during Dodonga Caravan (mission).

Alien Nation (Japanese: , Bunkakōryū, Cultural Exchange) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Alex at West Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. Although it is not required, the Basic Mission A Concerned Citizen can be used to locate this mission.
Amends for a Brother is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located near the Water Purification Plant in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between Phog and Cross at any time.

Alluring Lophid Extracts are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black lava-dwelling Lophids in Primordia or Cauldros. Three are needed for The Next Big Thing in order to make a new type of cologne. They are also used to craft rank X - XX Overdrive: Gain TP augments.
Amber Aetrygon Horns are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from white Aetrygons in Sylvalum. They are used to craft SpecUp.FUEL-PARK augments.

The Ajoa Cantor (Japanese: , Ajoa Imupureka) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Cantor family, and is fought at level 23 at the Biahno Water-Purification Plant in Primordia during the Normal Mission Lakeside Getaway. Depending on the route choice if Ajoa is allowed to take a shower, the egg inside her will hatch and it will become the Ajoa Cantor. Otherwise, this enemy is not fought.

Alluring Papil Scales are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from purple Papils in Primordia, Noctilum, or Oblivia. One is needed to craft a Sandstorm Screen or Weather.S-STORM-RES augment.

Ambush is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Lara Nara and the primary destination is the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. This mission leads into the Normal Mission Attack on Biahno Hills, although this mission itself is not a prerequisite.
Ajiba's Key is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It's obtained from Ajiba Falgo at Oblivia's Milligan Supply Base after he is fought during Kidnapped: Oll Valdileo.
Aeviter Ace is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Dopang Caravan and the primary destination is Sylvalum.

Amber Dilus Eyes are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the heads of brown Diluses in Oblivia. One is needed for The Carrot. Twenty-four are required to craft an Overdrive Green Bonus augment.
The Aerozium (English dub: ) is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Four pieces must be found at Oblivia's Floating Reef for Fitting In.

Amber Cervus Antlers are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from orange Cervuses, or for 114 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components for SpecUp.FUEL-COST augments.
Aeviter Death Stones are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from yellow Aeviters, or for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Aeviter Membranes are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Aeviters.
Aeviter A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a purple aeviter variant. It can be obtained from Berthold, the Blue-Eyed in Sylvalum.
Aeviter B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a yellow aeviter variant. It can be obtained from Balduino, the Wicked-Eyed in Noctilum.
Aetrygon A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white aetrygon variant. It can be obtained from Ramus, the Supersonic in Sylvalum.
Aetrygon B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a brown aetrygon variant. It can be obtained from Vilem, the Gold-Scaled in Oblivia.

Agitated Progen is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.15, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting four Sarcosuchus, the Iron-Eaters. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Air Supremacy is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.18, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting thirty-six Zigs. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Alexa's Bodywear is Casual Wear upper-body armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Alexa's initial gear when she is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Alexa's Legwear is Casual Wear leg armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Alexa's initial gear when she is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.

The Agent's Suit is Casual Wear full-body armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It can only be obtained as a reward for a non-repeatable mission, so only one Agent's Suit can be obtained per playthrough. It's an upgraded version of the Dark Suit.
Ajoa's ID Card is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from Ajoa Cantor at Primordia's Biahno Water-Purification Plant during the A route of Lakeside Getaway.
The Affinity Chart (Japanese: , kizunaguramu, Kizunagram) is a major game mechanic in .
Alrest (Japanese: , Arusuto) is the world and setting of and .
The Aegises (, Ten no seihai, lit. Heavenly Holy Grail) are legendary Blades in and .

Aft (Japanese: , Afuto) is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian boy who can be found at Bower Lounge in the Argentum Trade Guild. He is involved in the quest Hide and Seek where he must be found along with two Nopon friends. Aft offers no quests or merc missions.

The Aegis War was an event that occurred 494 years prior to the events of , circa 3564, and serves as the setting for . It refers to the struggle between Malos and Mythra, and the war itself led to the deaths of three major Titans, including Coeia and Torna. The Titans Genbu and Temperantia were scarred in the conflict as well, with Temperentia's landscape being changed drastically.

The Aion Hangar Entrance (Japanese: , Aiōn Kakunōko-mae) is a landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the First Low Orbit Station, above the Colossus Hangar and leading into the Aion Hangar. The Heart-to-Heart "Before the Storm" is located here. There are no enemies here.

Alioth, Elevator #3 (Japanese: , Shehakimu Dai-3 Erebētā) is a location in . It is located on the Mid Level of the World Tree, between Lv. 3, Alioth and the Megrez Gateway. There are no enemies here, but it is impossible to reach the elevator without engaging the Mk. VI Gerolf.
Adventures of Myram are Literature Pouch items in . They can be purchased from the Reedirait Bookstore in the Argentum Trade Guild. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Godfrey.
The Aldomar Deeds are Store Deed key items in . They can be purchased from Aldomar Books in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Airy Snowflake Sherbets are Dessert Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Placks Patisserie in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Aldomar Books is a shop in . It is run by Cybine and located in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is specialized in Literature.
Adwen is an NPC in . She is a Gormotti who can be found in the Gormott Province's Torigoth. Adwen runs a shop called Café Savvy which specializes in Drinks. Adwen offers no quests or merc missions.

The Aion Hangar (Japanese: , Aiōn Kakunōko) is a location in . It is located on the Lower Level of the First Low Orbit Station, beyond the Aion Hangar Entrance, and is the last location in the game. It cannot be visited outside the final battle. It is where Artifice Aion is held.

Aegishammer (Japanese: , Seihai no Tettsui) is a Location in . It is a large crater located on the Central Plain of Temperantia, in the northeasternmost extremities of the area. It is a wound to the Titan dealt by the Aegis during the Aegis War. There is a Phonex village here which must be visited during A Phonex Tale.
Aerial Slash (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Chroma Katana.
Aligos (Japanese: , Diburo) are a family of enemies in the . They resemble sharks with arms, and come in red and green varieties.
Amari Vangs (Japanese: , Amerisu Vanpu) are enemies in . They are members of the Vang family and can be found at level 17-19 in Windpipe Deeps of the Kingdom of Uraya.
Albacon Frystacks are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Speck Butchers in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. Four are needed to unlock Cressidus' level 4 Berserk March.

Agam Grebels (Japanese: , Agāme Tasuman) are enemies in . They are members of the Grebel family, and can be found at level 45-47 at the Toxbloom and Xataris Springs in the Central Plain area of Temperantia.

Ahaato Gyannas (Japanese: , Ahato Gyanomu) are enemies in . They are members of the Gyanna family, and can be found at level 45 - 47 at the Underground River Lavi in the Upper Level area of the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Affection Rings are accessories in and . They increase the HP restored when reviving a teammate by up to 39% of their maximum health. They are the upgraded version of the Friendship Ring accessory. The Promise Ring accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect. It can stack with the additive HP recovering effects of the teammate's Grandarbor Ward, Spirit Tree Ward or World Tree Ward accessories.

Alphabet Courses (Japanese: , Shihan ni Manabu ABC) are accessories in . They increase the amount of Weapon Points earned by 25% when the wearer defeats enemies during combat. This effect applies to the entire party, but the boost will only take effect if the wearer lands the killing blow. The effect will stack together with all "Weaponsmaster" Common Blade Skills currently engaged on the wearer, but does not stack with Chain Attack Overkills. Only one can be obtained per playthrough. The Alphabet Course+ accessory is the upgraded version of this equipment.
Alonzo Standards (Japanese: , Aronzo Furaggu) are enemies in . They are Standards, and can be found at level 49-51 at the Ardainian Garrison in Temperantia.

Amethyst Chips are Core Chips in and in . They can be dropped by enemies in the Kingdom of Uraya or the Kingdom of Torna. Amethyst Chips share their appearance with Spinel Chips, Fluorite Chips and Turquoise Chips. __TOC__

Allies of Justice 2 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province after completing the mission Allies of Justice 1. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Water Mastery", "Keen Eye" and "Clairvoyant Eye" Field Skills. This mission unlocks Allies of Justice 3 and the third level of Godfrey's "Passionate Soul" Field Skill.

Allies of Justice 1 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya automatically after Godfrey joins the party. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fire Mastery", "Nopon Wisdom" and "Chivalry" Field Skills. This mission unlocks Allies of Justice 2 and the second level of Godfrey's "Passionate Soul" Field Skill.

Allies of Justice 6 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal after completing the mission Allies of Justice 5. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Dark Mastery", "Fortitude" and "Leaping" Field Skills. This mission unlocks the fourth row of Godfrey's Affinity Chart, which is required in order to start his Blade Quest Flames of Justice.

Allies of Justice 4 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago after completing the mission Allies of Justice 3. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Wind Mastery", "Transport Mastery" and "Fleet of Foot" Field Skills. This mission unlocks Allies of Justice 5 and the third level of Godfrey's "Justice-Loving Soul" Field Skill.

Allies of Justice 5 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain after completing the mission Allies of Justice 4. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Electric Mastery", "Info Collector" and "Phonex Linguistics" Field Skills. This mission unlocks Allies of Justice 6 and the second level of Godfrey's "Kind Soul" Field Skill.

Altaer Drivers (Japanese: , Arutaru Doraibā) are quest-exclusive enemies in . They are Drivers that can be found at level 47 on the Ayvill Shopping Dist., Roof in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the quest Fool's Gold.
Alda Sentries are enemies in . They are Sentries, and can be found at level 57 - 59 at the Sky Bridge or at level 59 - 61 on Lv. 3, Alioth in the World Tree.

Alisdeigh is an NPC in . Alisdeigh is an Ardainian archeologist who can be found at the Beraf Industry Ward in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Alisdeigh gives the quest The Nopon Murals, during which he is found at the Waypoint Market in Garfont Village in Uraya. He is one of two NPCs who can be invited to Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago during the quest History Teacher. If invited to Fonsett Village, he can be found teaching at the Azure Schoolhouse.

Aegaeon's Core Crystal is a special Core Crystal in . It allows Aegaeon to be awakened by Mòrag. Emperor Niall grants it to Mòrag after deciding he is unfit to be a Driver. Engaging in battle (not necessarily defeating the enemy) 22 times is needed in order for Aegaeon to be awakened.
Alban is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found at the Fonsa Myma Port in the Kingdom of Uraya. Alban gives the quest Follow Your Passion.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Aerial Hunter (Japanese: , Furaiyā Hantā) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It increases the damage dealt against Aerial creatures by up to 45%. Aerial-type enemies belong to the following enemy species: Ansel, Aspid, Ekidno, Flier, Hiln, Laia, Lexos, Medooz, Moramora, Peng, Pterix, Quadwing, Rhogul, Skeeter, Taos, Vang and Wisp. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. Poppi α is not compatible with this part. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Affinity MAX Acc (Japanese: , Kizuna MAX Meichū) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It increases accuracy by up to 40% when the Affinity between Driver and Blade is at max. This effect persists until the golden bond dissipates. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Affinity MAX Barrier (Japanese: , Kizuna MAX Baria) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM / Upgrade in and . It grants a party-wide damage barrier that nullifies up to 35% of the Driver's maximum HP in damage, once the Affinity between Driver and Blade reaches its max. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Affinity MAX Evade (Japanese: , Kizuna MAX Kaihi) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM / Upgrade in and . It increases Evasion Rate by up to 18% when the Affinity between Driver and Blade is at max. This effect persists until the golden bond dissipates. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. The Crimson Orchid Brighid and Jade Orchid Brighid DLC Aux Cores have equivalent effects to this Aux Core's Rank V variant. __TOC__

Aggro Attack Up (Japanese: , Heito Kōgeki Appu) is an Aux Core in and . It increases damage dealt to enemies targeting the user by up to 35%. For the Skill RAM/Upgrade used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ with an equivalent effect to this equipment, check Vendetta. __TOC__

Ambush Boost (Japanese: , Fuiuchi Kyōka) is an Aux Core in and . It boosts damage dealt by surprise attacks by up to 110%. Surprise attacks occur when the player attacks the enemy on the back before they detect them. This equipment's effect stacks additively with the default 50% damage increase of surprise attacks. For the Skill RAM/Upgrade used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ with an equivalent effect to this equipment, check Silent Strike. __TOC__

Alban's Paintings are Key Items in . They are needed to complete the quest Follow Your Passion. There are three in total, and they can be obtained from the crates next to the grounded ship on the Isle of Terminomni in the Leftherian Archipelago during the quest.
Aki is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti boy who can be found at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain after leaving Indol. He is friends with Bonono. He proposes the quest World Tree Disaster.

Albina is an NPC in . She is a young Urayan who can be found at Seoris Plaza in the Indoline Praetorium. She is involved in the quest Mellica the Chorister, where she hired a driver to deal with Mellica who got into the Indoline choir.

All's Fair (Japanese: , Koi wa Mōdoku, Romantic Love is Deadly Poison) is a Blade Quest in . It is received by speaking to Genedd, who only appears when Pyra or Mythra and Mòrag is in the party, at Fonsa Myma Port in the Kingdom of Uraya after sending Azami on the Surveillance Merc Mission. It unlocks new Merc Missions and Azami's level 3 Key Affinity once completed.

Aifil is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian shopkeeper who can be found in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He runs a shop called Carwood Blacksmiths that specializes in Core Chips. Aifil offers no quests or merc missions.

Albatross Cut (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Infinity Fans. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Halo Strike.

Allain is an NPC in . He is a Urayan shopkeeper who can be found in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. He runs a shop called Lleman Blacksmiths specialized in Core Chips. Allain offers no quests or merc missions.

The Ambushing Flamii (Japanese: , Machibuse no Furamī) is a quest-exclusive enemies in . It is a member of the Flamii family and can be found at level 25 in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya during The Titan Scholar.

Affinity Extend is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It extends the range of the Affinity Bond between Driver and Blade by up to 2 meters, making the bond easier to maintain while moving or when the Tora is inflicted with Stench. It is equivalent in effect to the Red Thread, Love Thread and Passion Thread accessories. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

Agility Boost (Japanese: , Subayasa Purasu) is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases Tora's Agility stat by up to 15. This effect applies even when the Poppi form equipped with this part isn't active on the field. It is equivalent in effect to the Wolf Shoes and Spring Shoes accessories. It can be used to customize Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. Poppi α is not compatible with this part. __TOC__

Affinity Down is a status effect in and . It decreases the Affinity between a Driver and a Blade of the party. The amount of Affinity loss is 400, which is enough to lower the level of the Affinity Bond by 2 tiers.
Alemma is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian Soldier who can be found in Hardhaigh Palace in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Alulu is an NPC in . She is a Nopon child and a friend of Bonono. She is the Driver of an animal Common Blade named Festa. She is first met during World Tree Disaster, and can be found at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain upon the quest's completion. Alulu is from the Indoline Praetorium, although she is never seen there. She and Bonono fall onto the World Tree when Indol moves, and here Alulu accidentally awakens her Blade by touching a Core Crystal that has fallen with them.

Alicia is an NPC in . She is an Ardainian who can be found on a cliff above the Garfont Training Ground in the Kingdom of Uraya. At night, she is found at Vargel Tavern, serving drinks to tired mercenaries, but only if she is hired. She is one of three NPCs who can be hired as admin of the Garfont Mercenaries during the quest Leadership Qualities. She is originally from the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Arachno Queen is a boss in . The party faces it upon leaving Colony 9, in the Arachno Queen's Nest in Tephra Cave. It is also one of the only bosses faced with only two characters, Shulk and Reyn. The Arachno Queen resembles a spider of incredible large proportions. Her jaws are in a unique position, but otherwise her appearance matches most large spider species despite having only four legs.

Aqua Nebulae on Bionis' Leg drop the Light Rain Element needed during Colony 6 Reconstruction. There is another variant which appears in Satorl Marsh. They have different game statistics and drop different treasure in each area.

According to their description, they have been maturing for 300 years and words can't describe the taste. Four are required to build level five Commerce in Colony 6. In , they can be purchased in the Time Attack place from the Nopon Archsage for 7,900 Noponstones.

Ardun Elder Beards are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Magnis Ardun on the Bionis' Leg, and are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6 and Replica Monado 1. According to their description, they are beards of Armu leaders and using them as a skipping rope creates good luck. In Definitive Edition, they can be purchased in Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 7,500 Noponstones.

In , they can be purchased at the Time Attack place from the Nopon Archsage for 22,500 Noponstones.

It is located south from the Tranquil Square in the Residential District. It can only be reached, and therefore discovered, by swimming there. Following the recreation of the world of the Bionis, this Anti-Air Battery is the only one remaining. The Dark Murakmor can be found on the slope of the Anti-Air Battery, at night.

Kings (Japanese: , Kingu) are giant Antols with two abdomens instead of one, similar to Arachno Queens. In , Cloud Arachnos mistakenly use an Antol model; as no other Arachnos appear in the game, this enemy was likely intended to be an Antol.

It is a Unique Monster and a Mechon; it can be found at level 105 near Wreckage Beach on the Fallen Arm. As with the other Superbosses except Final Marcus, it appears after the events at the Mechonis Core. As a Mechon, it cannot be harmed by regular weapons unless it is Toppled or unless those weapons have been enchanted by the Monado, and as a large Mechon, it cannot be inflicted with Break outside of a Chain Attack. According to their description, they are machines designed to look like an angel alighting. Obtaining one will unlock the "Angelic Imitation" achievement.

Amethyst Melons (Japanese: , Ameshisuto Remon, Amethyst Lemon) are collectables in . They can be found in Sword Valley and Colony 6. According to their description, they are seen as a dessert fruit and are also valued as decorative plants.

Anti-Air Battery 1 (Japanese: , Taikū-hō 1-gō Ki) is a location in . It is in Colony 9, one of the three Anti-Air Batteries used to protect Colony 9 from falling Mechon debris, along with any Mechon if they were to invade. It is found northwest of the Commercial District, outside the colony itself. The battery is very close to the shore, and it is not hard to swim under. The land closest to it is inhabited by various monsters.

Anti-Air Battery 2 (Japanese: , Taikū-hō 2-gō Ki) is a location in . It is one of the three Anti-Air Batteries in Colony 9 used to protect Colony 9 from falling Mechon debris, along with any potential Mechon invaders. It is to the northeast of the main part of the Colony, and north of Agora Shore. This location can only be reached by swimming. It is surrounded by Throne Sardi and residence to six Resplendent Flamii. To the north of it there is an unnamed shore, with more Resplendent Flamii, as well as some Opulent Flamii and the Flailing Bracken. The two Fallen Objects required for Presents for Priceless Pupils can be found here (one on the shore, and one on the battery itself).

When Shulk arrives here from Vilia Lake, he finds Reyn surrounded by Arachnos. He manages to save him by learning and using Monado Shield. They then proceed to fight the Arachno Queen. There is a passage leading from the nest to Kneecap Hill.
Aqua Tops are medium torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are only available from the Nopon Merchant Camp in Satorl Marsh.

Arduns (Japanese: , Arudon) are enemies in the . They are somewhat similar in appearance to a rhino crossed with a triceratops, and highly similar to Armus: there are very few differences between an Ardun and an Armu; according to the Traditional Chinese localization of , and the English localization of , Arduns and Armus are, respectively, the male and female versions of the same species. With the exception of Herculean Gibson (a Golden Monster), Relentless Arduran (resembles a Balgas), and Kilocorn Grandeps (a Superboss with a unique appearance), all Arduns share one model.
Aqua Bottoms are medium legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from the Nopon Merchant Camp in Satorl Marsh.

Arachnos (Japanese: , Supaido; English dub: ) are a type of four-legged, spider-like enemies in the . Queens (Japanese: , Kuīn) are a much larger kind of Arachno with two abdomens instead of one, similar to Antol Kings. The Cloud Arachno uses an Antol model, and was likely intended to be an Antol enemy.

It can be received from Talia at the Ether Plant in Eryth Sea after completing either Investigating Satorl or Talia's Research. Melia must be in the lead. Completing this quest will unlock Melia's fifth skill branch, Passion.

The Anti-Mechon Striker (Japanese: , Kyōka Tachi: Kizan, Reinforced Tachi: Machine Killer) is an Anti-Mechon weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a sword wielded by Dunban, and can only be acquired by purchasing it at the Supply Convoy Shop in Sword Valley for 26,880 G.

Anti-Mechon Snipers (Japanese: , Kyōka Sunaipu: Kigeki, Reinforced Sniper: Machine Attacker) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are rifles wielded by Sharla. They can only be acquired by purchasing them at the Supply Convoy Shop for 27,600 Gold.

Anti-Mechon Biters (Japanese: , Kyōka Kamukamu: Kigeki, Reinforced Biter: Machine Attacker) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are biters wielded by Riki. They can only be obtained at the Supply Convoy Shop for 25,800 Gold.
The Anti-Mechon Rod (Japanese: , Kyōka Roddo: Kigeki, Reinforced Rod: Machine Attacker) is a staff wielded by Melia that can only be purchased at the Supply Convoy Shop for 24,600 Gold.

The Ancient Lily is a Key Item in . It is needed for A Flower for a Rose. The party is asked by Dulland to collect it from Bafalgar Tomb in Tephra Cave. It is found at the end of the corridor from the hidden door, behind the altar.

Aqueous Andos Oils are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Flavel Andos in Eryth Sea and traded for in Eryth Sea and Alcamoth. According to their description, they are oils that normally act like water but thicken when applied. During Mystery of Makna Ruins 3, the party is asked to collect three of them.

Ancient Ceremony Offerings (Japanese: , Gishiki no Junbi) is a Story Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is automatically triggered at the Sororal Statues of Satorl Marsh during the course of The Ancient Ceremony. It is required to complete The Ancient Ceremony.

The Archaeology Centre (Japanese: , Iseki Kenkyū Honbu) is a location in . It is on the fifth floor of Frontier Village, and is home or workplace to several Nopon - Tuzu and Pachipa can be found here during the day, and Lupa is present at night. As revealed in , the Ponspectors also work for the Archaeology Centre as an elite surveyors team.

The Arachno Feeding Lair (Japanese: , Supaido no Kariba) is a location in . It is located in the second floor of Tephra Cave. It is southwest of Trader's Stopover and east of the Arachno Queen's Nest. The party must traverse the lair to get to the Path of Absolution.

Archer Hodes (Japanese: , Tehito Fūdi) are enemies in . They are members of the Hode family, and can be found at level 34 at Showdown Cliff or Hovering Reef 2 in the Eryth Sea, alongside Unine Hodes and Pulse Orlugas. Six Archer Hodes must be defeated for the quest Back Pain. They drop Luxury Hode Woods, three pieces of which are needed for the quest Mend the Plant.

Anu Shore (Japanese: , Anu Kaigan) is a location in . It is located in Eryth Sea, directly north of the entrance to the High Entia Tomb. It is made up of two parts, a lower beach and a clifftop, which are accessed separately. The clifftop can be reached from the Tomb by jumping in the water and swimming for the cave in the wall, and the beach is most easily reached by jumping to Centre Gate, running along its support beam and swimming the rest of the way. While the beach teems with enemies, including one Unique Monster, the Bizarre Ragoel, the cliff is fairly peaceful and uninhabited aside from a few Stella Eks and the Lightspeed Sonid. Andos Antennae are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Azul Andos in the High Entia Tomb, or traded for in Alcamoth. According to their description, they can receive all manner of waves and are known for eavesdropping. Three of them are needed to complete Collect Quest 2.

Arachno Sickles are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be traded for with Kofuko, or dropped by Arachnos in Tephra Cave. According to their description, they are very sharp sickles that are hugely helpful during harvest time. Four of them are required to complete Friendship Tokens.
